Used as the decision engine through unaware/foulplay_brain.py. One local change:
fp/battle/protocol.py wraps each protocol handler in try/except, so a single line
it cannot parse (seen with Revival Blessing on an Illusion Zoroark) no longer
stops the whole battle loop.
